questions.question: 'Look at the top 5 cards of either deck.' With 3 or more players, which decks can be looked at?
readings: (A) Any one player's deck: P1 picks any player still in the game and looks at that deck (the data's pick-a-faction shape already allows this).

(B) P1's own deck or the deck of the block's chosen opponent (the MP 2/MP 3 two-player idiom: 'either' = one of 'both players'); P1 chooses the opponent when the trigger resolves, then one of the two decks.
questions.recommendation: (B). The guidelines turn 'your opponent' and 'both players' into you plus one selected opponent; 'either deck' is the same two-player idiom, and (B) keeps the choice to two decks as printed.

questions.question: 'If your opponent plays a character, you may remove a token from this card.' A trigger condition names 'your opponent', but triggers choose their opponent only when they resolve. Which opponent's play triggers it?
